related.title: Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以可用能量窗口與老化建立起點，接到通風短路與盲區的系統介面，最後用能量模型未涵蓋的安全證據整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Usable-energy window and ageing, connect through Ventilation bypass and dead zones, then integrate evidence using Safety evidence beyond the energy model. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船舶電池艙安全工程
history.text: 本專題以可用能量窗口與老化建立起點，接到通風短路與盲區的系統介面，最後用能量模型未涵蓋的安全證據整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Usable-energy window and ageing, connect through Ventilation bypass and dead zones, then integrate evidence using Safety evidence beyond the energy model. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 分開容量、散熱、通風與告警證據，避免把續航算例當成電池艙安全設計。 在電池艙能量與熱管理數位室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Separate capacity, cooling, ventilation and alarm evidence so endurance calculations are not mistaken for battery-room safety design. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Battery-room energy/thermal digital studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
